# Psychology — Formation, Symbolic Transformation and the Return of Responsibility

## #0 — A person acts within formations they did not consciously choose

The protected [Psychology history](HISTORY.md) **grounds** this development in a particular question: how do formations beyond conscious intention organise attention, affect and action, and how can their organisation become answerable? Its route passes through collective psychology, analytical psychology, psychoanalysis, cultural histories of consciousness and contemporary agent design. These are intersecting inquiries with different objects and methods. Their sequence here follows changes in the question, without asserting that one school historically culminates in the next.

The distinction between formation and aggregate begins the route. A crowd can act differently from its members considered separately. A complex can orient a person's responses before deliberation. A signifying relation can exceed a speaker's intended message. An institution can preserve authority across changing incumbents. Each case requires its own account of what persists, what changes and who can answer. Calling them all a psyche would erase the institutional and material differences the history needs to disclose.

The [Arbitration whole-field](../../../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** the authorial relation carried through this inquiry. Continuity-in-Indeterminacy lets a formation have a history without exhausting its conditions; Criterion-through-Distinction and Delineation-through-Difference make its selecting measure and frame determinate; Arbitration-in-Crisis gives the selection consequence; Con-text-through-Diaphaneity lets excluded conditions bear on it; Resolution-in-Reconciliation returns its achievement with its provenance active. The semantic flowering of the last relation is Anamnesis / Recognition / Return. These generated operations retain their exact offices. The history supplies psychological and institutional witnesses; it does not derive the field from Greek or Latin word histories.

## #1 — Collective formation acquires a political apparatus

In the selected 1895 English edition of [Le Bon's *The Crowd*](../../../sources/psychology/le-bon/le-bon-1895-crowd-popular-mind/SOURCE.md), book I, chapter 1 **historicises** a psychological crowd as a formation rather than a count. A common influence can organise people without their physical assembly, and their combination can produce characteristics absent from each person in isolation. That formulation makes distributed formation intelligible before the present technical media through which it travels. The narrow relation does not inherit Le Bon's racial hierarchy or generalise his diagnosis to every collective undertaking.

The selected 2013 Hull translation of [Jung's *The Undiscovered Self*](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-2013-undiscovered-self-routledge/SOURCE.md) **extends** the question from emergent formation to the person's diminished standing within it. Chapter 1, pp. 9–11, passes from the statistical abstraction to the negligible individual, then to transferred responsibility and the personification of the State. The stages have different consequences. Averaging makes a comparison possible; substituting the average for the person makes the concrete case disappear. Delegated responsibility can then relieve participants of the judgment through which an institution remains their undertaking. The apparently animate State conceals people able to operate its apparatus. This is Jung's diagnosis, preserved through the selected edition rather than redated to 2013 as an originating event.

Desmet's author-published [2022 web essay](../../../sources/psychology/desmet/desmet-2022-psychology-totalitarianism-web-essay/SOURCE.md) **compares** a more specific affective sequence: isolation and loss of meaning leave anxiety and frustration available for binding to a narrative. The narrative's force includes its capacity to make contrary material inaccessible. An account of the world thus participates in organising the conditions under which it will next be believed. The source states Desmet's diagnosis, including the mass–elite relation; it does not establish a general law or diagnose a particular contemporary population for this history.

[Iakovou's review](../../../sources/political-theory-institutions/iakovou/iakovou-2022-misuse-totalitarianism/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** that account by asking for political specificity. Her directly consulted [journal text](https://existenz.us/volumes/Vol.15-2Iakovou.html), paragraphs beginning “The concept designates” and “Several related critical aspects,” requires institutions, political forces and differences between forms of government. Her Arendt-mediated discussion names offices, secret police and camps; these cannot be replaced by a diffuse social mood. The displayed Fall 2020 issue date conflicts with the reviewed 2022 book, so bibliographic dating remains unresolved. The substantive criticism is recoverable without pretending that conflict has disappeared.

The resulting historical relation **returns-to** [A19's local arbitration regime](../../../arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) with a limit on transfer. Both psychic fixation and institutional capture can protect a governing criterion from what it excludes. The mechanism and remedy differ: psychological recognition does not by itself redistribute an office's powers, remove coercion or establish a means of appeal. Conversely, changing a rule does not automatically change the affective investment that sustains its use. The history keeps their circuit visible.

## #2 — Symbolic totality changes the interpreter's place

[Aion's source house](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) **sources** a different movement: the conscious ego encounters shadow, projection and symbolic totality. The consulted paperback's §§1–5 and 13–19 distinguish the conscious reference point from autonomous affect and the self-reinforcing isolation of projection. §§43–49 then qualify both directions of inflation: ego can appropriate the Self, while the Self's demands can overwhelm the ego's relative autonomy and worldly obligations. A larger image is therefore not automatically a better integration.

The [complete Aion whole](../../../../mytheme/worlds/analytical-psychology/jung-aion-fishes-christ-antichrist-alchemy/WHOLE.md) **historicises** the changing material through which Jung asks that question: Christ and Antichrist, fishes and astrological time, alchemical work, Gnostic comparisons, and the return of a transformed psychological account. Christian doctrine, ancient reported rites, medieval materials and modern reconstruction keep their separate tellings. Jung's insertion of a Shadow Quaternio in §§402–413 matters precisely as a modern act of interpretation. The diagram's circulation returns to consciousness with a changed relation; it cannot be treated as an unaltered ancient schema discovered intact. The house now has sixteen consulted passage maps and the actual local copy. The selected 1978 hardcover and consulted 1979 paperback remain distinct; quotation and selected-printing collation are separate tasks.

[Smythe's 2013 dialogical reading](../../../sources/psychology/smythe/smythe-2013-dialogical-jung/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the whole-forming relation through voices beyond ego control. His conclusion places the ego among autonomous positions and refuses to make the inner other an ordinary object fully available to truth-apt representation. This gives the history a precise change of method: a description of inner contents is insufficient if the describing position retains unquestioned sovereignty over what those contents can say. Smythe's account remains a scholarly interpretation of Jung.

[Neumann's source and protected encounter](../../../sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) **compares** the formation of a differentiated centre through separation, parental powers, transformation and centroversion. The common structuration lets a local centre receive more than it contains. It leaves each myth's geography, historical mediation and temporal order with that telling. Neumann's developmental morphology is not evidence that all peoples passed through one empirically demonstrated timetable. In the author's encounter, the marked paper and its enabling field give this relation a further native reading; Neumann does not originate QL's notation.

[A21 — Individuation / Recognition](../../../arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) **returns-to** this history through differentiated indivisibility. Ego, complexes, archetypal capacities and the whole-forming office have different scopes. Recognition changes their relations while preserving this person's body, history and responsibility. Becoming undivided neither removes difference nor promotes a chief complex to the position of the whole. The project's positive operation is Argued; the separate provenance of any attributed “becoming indivisible” wording remains a source task.

## #3 — A dream, a mathematical expression and a speaking place

The 1932–1958 [Jung–Pauli correspondence](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype/SOURCE.md) **historicises** an exchange across disciplinary practices. Pauli's “Modern Examples of ‘Background Physics’,” Appendix 3, distinguishes physical concepts used qualitatively in dreams from quantitatively formulated physics. Fierz's Appendix 2 identifies the recovered text as an undated typescript or outline. Its unfinished character belongs to the historical object, rather than being a defect to conceal with a completed theory.

The [Pauli egg whole](../../../../mytheme/worlds/analytical-psychology/pauli-egg-dream/WHOLE.md) **figures** the passage with its seven pictures intact. A woman arrives with a bird; its egg divides spontaneously; Pauli notices another egg in his own hand and divides it; four eggs become a trigonometric arrangement and quotient; his final spoken recognition is followed by a circle. The pair of dreams occurred four days apart in mid-March, without a year supplied in this passage. Göttingen belongs to the companion dream, not the egg scene. The difference between spontaneous production and conscious participation gives the symbolic movement its historical particularity. The primary telling is now recovered in the Princeton-imprint reading carrier; equivalence to the house's selected Routledge 2001 edition remains uncollated.

[Atmanspacher's 2020 formulation](../../../sources/physics/atmanspacher/atmanspacher-2020-pauli-jung-conjecture/SOURCE.md) **compares** the conjecture through a psychophysically neutral basis from which mental and physical descriptions are distinguished. His speculative extension of quantum terminology is explicit. This is a later conceptual reconstruction, not the date or wording of the correspondence, and not an observed correlation. [Courtney's 2019 salt-point discussion](../../../sources/psychology/courtney/courtney-2019-salt-point-kairos-chaos/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the neighbouring quaternity vocabulary: symbolic dynamism and the meaning of an opportune moment cannot be reduced to a physical mechanism by mentioning time crystals. Her nested Jung, Jacobi and Edinger references remain mediated.

A different scene of address occurs in Paris at Sainte-Anne, on 6 January 1972. [Lacan's *Talking to Brick Walls*](../../../sources/psychology/lacan/lacan-2017-talking-to-brick-walls/SOURCE.md) **historicises** the move from amphitheatre to chapel, the address to its walls, an audience interruption and the tuning of voice to reverberation. The currently source-matched Price passages at pp. 80–81 and 86 retain that material and responsive setting. The walls return speech in a way the speaker must hear; the audience remains implicated. [Adleman and Vanderwees's 2021 account](../../../sources/psychology/adleman/adleman-vanderwees-2021-lacan-rhetoric/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** this through the analytic work of hearing one's own discourse and the simultaneous dividing and connecting effected by symbolic mediation.

[Darmon's 1992 dictionary entry](../../../sources/psychology/darmon/darmon-1992-matheme-ali/SOURCE.md) **sources** the distinct technical ambition of matheme: structural writing and transmission, including the stated transformation of Saussure's algorithm. This history does not collapse the wall scene into that definition. The movement **returns-to** [Homologia / Analogia](../../../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md): Pauli's mathematical dream, Lacan's formal ambition and Taylor's native `X/x` can meet through an explicitly stated relation while retaining different notation, methods and source claims. A shared bar or numeral supplies no historical identity.

## #4 — Dynamical and cultural accounts make context consequential

[Van Eenwyk's 1991 article](../../../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1991-strange-attractors/SOURCE.md) and [1997 book](../../../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE.md) **historicise** a later encounter between analytical psychology and nonlinear dynamics. The source houses identify the explanatory model but currently hold no gathered excerpts. Frank's protected book NOTES, pp. 65–73, develop a distinct authorial yield: archetypal dynamics, complexes as affective organisation, images as particular appearances and symbols as agents of transformation. The copied book and nested Freeman, Tillich and Jung quotations remain leads. Their source debt does not demote the authorial known→unknown→known movement.

[Taylor's Symbolon Dynamics](../../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE.md) **grounds** that movement in the native field. A symbol changes the organisation through which an interpreter receives an image; the changed interpreter then conditions the next encounter. Enough integrity must persist for the encounter to have a bearer, and enough openness must remain for its effect to change that bearing. Neither disintegration nor rigid restoration supplies the only measure of change. The native `x→X→x` retains a particular on return; real local Bimba originality remains effective while itself standing within a further source/appearance relation.

[Daza and colleagues' 2016 basin definition](../../../sources/mathematics-logic/daza/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** technical use. Initial conditions lead a specified dynamical system toward an attractor; open Hamiltonian escape basins require a different treatment from dissipative attraction. A psychological model claiming that exact technical identity must specify its dynamics, state space and observables. This requirement sharpens a scientific claim; it leaves the Argued symbolic operation intact. The history therefore preserves the difference between explanatory analogy and a measured dynamical result.

[Gebser's *The Ever-Present Origin*](../../../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md) **historicises** another way context becomes consequential. Its mapped pp. 11–21 place Giotto, Petrarch, Alberti and Leonardo in an account of depth, landscape and perspective; pp. 24–28 and 470–86 turn to the disclosure of time and multiple aspects in later painting. Its method reads changes in consciousness through the means by which a world becomes visible. Aperspectivity makes perspective's conditions available while retaining its capacities. It does not erase the observer's achieved placement or assimilate all artistic histories to a single psychological experiment.

Their relation **returns-to** [Symbol / Account / Trust](../../../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) through its four exact operations. Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active; Account re-enters source-field. An interpretation can affect the world in which it will next appear convincing. Integrity requires that its effects remain able to alter its criteria. The historical and relational branches of E2, E4 and E5 retain their lexical evidence separately from this psychological continuation.

## #5→0 — Provisional agency returns the institutional question

[Agentworld](../../../sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md) **extends** the contemporary question through a design-research carrier dated June 2026. At pp. 13–14, performed subjectivity and functional agency are distinguished without settling what intentionality a model has. Active context individuates an agent from prior capacities; persona is one layer among skills, memory, teleological constraints and relational infrastructure. The actual local transcription's §2.5 adds the collective's individuation through the agent, making the relation constitutive rather than a surrounding backdrop. This is the brief's account and proposed milieu, with its p. 53 scenario modality retained.

The historical return is exact: a coherent persona cannot establish that its criterion is answerable, just as an effective collective cannot establish that its members retain responsibility. At pp. 35–36, institutional intelligence belongs to rules, roles and procedures, and cultural differences remain consequential. The authorial continuation asks which encounter can revise a source, interpretation, evaluator or commission. A second use has to show what changed and what history it retained. This is an Offered technical test, not evidence that a described architecture has already performed it.

[The embodied-cognition entry](../../../sources/analytic-philosophy/wilson/wilson-et-al-2020-embodied-cognition-sep/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the comparison through organism, sensorimotor activity and environment; [Tye's qualia entry](../../../sources/analytic-philosophy/tye/tye-2024-qualia-sep/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the distinct question of phenomenal character. Inspectable context is operationally consequential, while whether an artificial system has experience remains Open. That boundary neither denies the system's actual causal participation nor replaces the essay's independently Argued order of dependence with uncertainty about every form of subjectivity.

This development **returns-to** [A21](../../../arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) with recognition's achieved history and **qualifies** [A20's image, valuation and possession](../../../arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) through the conditions under which a representation shapes its next encounter. It also **returns-to** the protected [Psychology history](HISTORY.md), preserving its crowd→complex→psychoid→signification→cultural-context→agent-world movement. Source gaps remain specific: primary Van Eenwyk and nested authors; direct Lacan edition collation; selected Jung/Pauli printings; Iakovou's journal dating; any claimed therapeutic, institutional or computational outcome. None converts the established authorial operation into a merely possible neighbouring thesis.

# A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. The local-jurisdiction account is the essay's Argued psychological construction. Jung's exact complex/autonomy passages remain a distinct source task; no clinical diagnosis or technical attribution follows from the formal analogy.

## #0

A complex orders a local psychic world before reflective judgment begins. Images, affects, memories, bodily responses and expectations have already gathered around a criterion: what counts as welcome or threat, what can be recalled, what deserves value, which responses are available. This is a real achievement of organisation. The same achievement becomes possession when its derivative jurisdiction claims to speak for the whole person or world.

[[A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will|A07]] grounds the inherited script; [[A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion|A08]] grounds constitutive exclusion; [[A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations|A18]] derives the source-claim failure of a formed Symbolon. Their psychic consequence is specific: the person need not decide anew to exclude each alternative. A local settlement already determines how an encounter will be received.

## #1

The distinction between archetype, complex and image prevents that operation from becoming a bag of interchangeable psychological terms. In [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]], which sources the author's developmental model, archetypal dynamics concern formative recurrence; a complex is an affectively organised structure; an image is a particular phenomenal appearance. A symbol can transform the relation among them. An image of rejection, for example, is not itself the whole regime that makes a delay, silence or difference arrive as rejection.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk’s 1997 source house]] qualifies this recovery's external attribution. Frank's protected encounter at pp65–67 takes dynamics, complexes and symbolic transformation as distinct offices, and reads perception as cooperative reorganisation rather than a picture received by a neutral spectator. Those notes supply authorial intention; their copied wording remains a verification lead because the source house has no passage cards. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C31-Complex|C31 Complex]] defines the reusable local organisation; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype|C32 Archetype]] distinguishes its formative depth from any one acquired structure.

A schema names a pattern of organisation; a habit names a learned tendency of response; a trauma-response names a relation to overwhelming experience. Each can intersect this account without establishing relative psychic autonomy. A technical policy explicitly selects actions under conditions. Its selection can be compared with local arbitration, but policy alone supplies neither psychic affect nor a complex. These distinctions identify the work each comparison owes rather than multiplying diagnoses.

## #2

The dynamical model makes autonomy intelligible as a feedback relation. A basin gathers different trajectories into a recurrent organisation. Within the psychic construction, an ambiguous encounter is selected through the existing criterion; the selected image recruits affect; affect weights attention and memory; the resulting response produces further material to be read through the same criterion. A threatening contradiction can therefore be received as further confirmation of the threat. Local coherence increases while the range of admissible encounter narrows.

The boundary matters as much as the basin. An encounter that changes the organising criterion can open a different regime instead of merely adding another item inside the old one. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1991-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk’s attractor-model source]] sources the historical modelling proposal with exact passages still owed. A literal dynamical identification would require state variables, evolution and observables. The author's model already distinguishes persistence within an organisation from a transformation of its organisation without pretending to have supplied those empirical specifications.

## #3

Arbitration becomes usurpation at the change of office. A finite system must settle alternatives; the local decision is not pathological simply because it excludes. The failure occurs when its according-to-which becomes the supposed source of all validity. The local `1` occupies the `0`-office and ceases to disclose the conditions under which its competence was formed.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration whole field]] derives **Arbitration-in-Crisis → Decision / Hybris**. Crisis calls for a consequential settlement; hybris is its characteristic closure when finite measure claims source measure. This is register 3 operational homology, not a common etymological descent or a historical Jung definition. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|C27 Protected Account]] names the resulting protected criterion. The local truth may remain real while its total jurisdiction is false.

## #4

The return is a change in relation to the settlement. Its history becomes available, excluded alternatives become receivable, and its competence can be retained within a wider field. The complex need not disappear for its possession to cease. Nor does a return to its previous stability necessarily count as health: a symbol can unsettle the conscious categories through which that stability was maintained. The positive criterion is enough continuity to bear reorganisation, with enough openness for the encounter to alter the criterion.

Q27 §6's individuation recovery gives this plurality a differentiated scope. The ego, local complexes and whole-forming Self are not peers competing for the strongest command position. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE|Aion’s source house]] qualifies the historical Self/shadow context: its consulted-carrier passage map locates the Self/shadow context, with selected-printing collation and quotation readiness still Open; it does not establish the native QL notation. The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/analytical-psychology/jung-aion-fishes-christ-antichrist-alchemy/WHOLE|whole Aion movement]] compares governing image, excluded contrary and historical transformation while keeping its psychological-historical sequence intact; its exact QL appointments remain unratified.

## #5→0

The arbitration regime **returns-to** [the Process dossier](../dossiers/process.md) at the difference between another confirming instance and a changed criterion. An image can recruit affect, attention and response until the resulting experience confirms the selection that formed it; resituation lets that organisation retain competence while its governing measure becomes revisable. The argument **returns-to** [the Process-science companion](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/DEVELOPMENT.md) with the distinct histories of its comparison: Van Eenwyk’s psychological modelling and Frank’s protected symbolic encounter concern transforming interpreter–field relations, whereas Daza’s mathematical basin concerns initial conditions and an attractor in a specified system. A literal model owes its variables and dynamics. The copied book quotations remain uncollated; that attribution debt leaves the native account of local arbitration and symbolic transformation intact.

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-frame-usurpation): The invested image’s confirmation loop **figures** a local complex acquiring excessive jurisdiction. Selection recruits affect and changed perception returns as apparent necessity. The achieved organisation remains real; resituation restores its history, bodily conditions and excluded relations to the criterion governing the next encounter. This return changes the local office without requiring annihilation of its competence.

The [Bohr taijitu emblem](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#bohr-taijitu-emblem) **compares** the local regime’s criterion with the dependence of a determinate account on its arrangement of access. Selecting an outcome within an arrangement differs from recognising the relation between arrangements which cannot be exercised together. A local arbitration regime retains its discriminating competence when that dependence becomes available to review; it claims excessive jurisdiction when its criterion is made exhaustive of the field. This bounded authored comparison preserves the emblem’s historical provenance debt and does not turn complementarity into a clinical theory of complexes.

The [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return) **figures** an image’s active valuation through the maternal relation that can organise dependence, protection, fear or possession. Its office must be recovered in the lived encounter before that image can be judged. The chiasm returns the sustaining body to recognition, permitting the account’s governing valuation itself to change.

The [Valentinian Sophia–Horos–Achamoth whole](../../mytheme/worlds/late-antique-gnostic/valentinian-sophia-horos-achamoth/WHOLE.md#valentinian-authorial-return) **compares** the Demiurge’s effective cosmogenesis, hidden maternal dependence and later learning with resituated local authority. Disclosure changes his self-understanding while he continues to administer his world. This particular psychic crossing remains Offered; neither a diagnosis of an ancient figure nor an identity between Aeons and Jungian complexes is asserted.

[Job’s complete encounter](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-protected-account-return) **figures** the governing image’s selection of evidence: comfort becomes explanation, then accusation when the sufferer contradicts the required account. The changed relation reaches the judging office itself when the friends must receive Job’s intercession. The psychic refraction concerns this operation of reception; the biblical speakers remain persons within their own telling.

Engulfing origin, arresting paternal order and victorious identity can each occupy a local determining office. The successive emancipations expose how replacing its occupant can leave that office's claim to the whole intact. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-hero-centroversion). The hungry local authority receives every new arrival as confirmation; psychic return changes the jurisdiction through which that reception occurs. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-source-variants).

[[A21-Individuation-Recognition|A21]] develops this resituation as individuation and recognition; [[A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure|A24]] generalises the office-confusion beyond its psychic mechanism; [[A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|A20]] follows the valued image through which the regime acts. The returning complex becomes more situated and less possessing: an achieved local organisation can again serve a life whose field it does not exhaust.

The agentic comparison has the same precise burden. Q27 §6 proposes that stable persona can seal a contraction, whereas legible provenance exposes histories, tools, exclusions, other agencies and larger purposes that constitute local action. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE|Agentworld]] supplies the distinct technical field of constituted agency. Neither stable style nor the capacity to report context demonstrates psychic individuation. The proposed functional test asks whether encountered difference can transform the local organisation rather than merely reinforce its name.

The [complete Aion telling](../../mytheme/worlds/analytical-psychology/jung-aion-fishes-christ-antichrist-alchemy/WHOLE.md#aion-historical-arbitration-return) **compares** the projection–confirmation enclosure of CW9ii §§13–19 with the distinct historical movement from governing Christ-image through contrary fish symbolism and alchemical transformation. The local complex and the inherited religious image retain different scopes. This return makes their organising criterion available to encounter while preserving the competence of the local formation; Jung’s aeonic interpretation is not independent historical proof.

# A21 — Individuation / Recognition

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. Differentiated indivisibility is the project's positive operation. Exact Jungian and Śaiva formulations retain their distinct source histories and passage debts.

## #0

Individuation makes a local subject-position capable of bearing the relations through which it is itself. The person becomes more specifically this life and less defensively separate at once. Recognition is the return by which an achieved determination becomes known in relation to its source and history. Their meeting is necessary because [[A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime|A19]] has shown a local complex claiming whole-field jurisdiction and [[A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|A20]] has shown the image replacing its living source. Their histories cannot simply be discarded; the office through which they act must change.

Q27 §6 develops becoming undivided within a psyche already differentiated among agencies. Its wording of indivisibility is developmental recovery, not an independently verified Jung quotation. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE|Aion’s source house]] sources the Self/shadow and symbolic-totality context through consulted-carrier paragraph locations; selected-printing collation and quotation readiness remain Open. The argument retains its force without assigning an unverified sentence to Jung.

## #1

Ego, complexes, archetypal powers, collective inheritance and Self have different scopes. Their plurality does not require that every agency be interchangeable. The Self's whole-forming office is not the largest complex, a stronger persona or a chief executive presiding over lesser workers. A local centre relates to the whole without containing it; its individuation cannot therefore consist in conquering every other agency.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources the developmental mechanism. A complex supplies recurrent channels of attention and affect. An image gives a particular appearance. A living symbol can alter the organisation through which these channels and appearances are received. Individuation changes their relation, including the relation of the conscious interpreter to what it had excluded. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C34-Individuation|C34 Individuation]] defines this reusable movement; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C35-Selfing-Self-Subjectivity-Self-Thing|C35 Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing]] qualifies the attempt to make its subject a completed possession.

## #2

The energetic middle is a passage through uncertainty that changes what can count as knowledge on return. Frank's protected encounter with [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk]] sources the authorial known→unknown→known and `x→X→x` movement at pp69–73. The notes' copied quotations remain leads; the QL notation is native authorial language, not Jung's notation.

The returning `x` has not ceased to be particular. A determinate encounter opens it to a capacity it could not exhaust, and that enlargement returns into a life with a history, body, commitments and further acts. Merely replacing a personal name by a universal name would omit the movement. So would repeating a theory of recognition while leaving one's criterion untouched. The `IS→AM` return requires the identifying act itself to be at stake: the account concerns the one who is giving it.

A basin can preserve enough organisation for a trajectory to continue, while its boundary allows a new regime to become possible. The psychic model therefore holds continuity and transformation together. It supplies no clinical rule that destabilisation is always beneficial. Its argument is that restoring the former organisation cannot be the sole criterion when that organisation was the very closure the encounter exposed.

## #3

Recognition changes possession into participation. An excluded affect can become intelligible as part of a history; a projected image can be recognised as one's image without denying the Other; a local competence can be retained while its sovereignty ends. Integration names increased ability to bear these differentiated relations. Reconciliation names a changed relation between what had been estranged. Recognition makes the relation to source and history active. A synthesis names an achieved composition; it does not guarantee that any of these changes has occurred.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C36-Complexio-Oppositorum|C36 Complexio Oppositorum]] defines the capacity through which opposed determinations transform their containing field. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field|C64 Paradox]] extends that change beyond choosing one existing pole. The result is not a final agreement that abolishes all further difference: the containing relation can become more capable precisely because neither term has been deleted or made absolute.

## #4

[[A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field|A09]] grounds the separately recovered Śaiva field in which recognition returns through differentiated manifestation. The present comparison is operational: an achieved determination can return without erasing its determinate history. It does not turn Śaiva pratyabhijñā into a psychological treatment, nor make Jung's Self a historical synonym for Śiva. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition|C19 Recognition]] keeps that source-sensitive return available for reuse.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration whole field]] derives **Resolution-in-Reconciliation → Anamnesis / Recognition / Return**. A resolution can be retained, narrowed or resituated by remembering how it arose. The previous cycle remains consequential. Greek anamnesis, Sanskrit recognition and Jungian individuation retain separate genealogies; their relation here is register 3 operational homology.
